import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load dataset into a pandas DataFrame
data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data), sep=',')

# Plot a bar chart for transaction types
sns.set()
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')

# Plot a histogram for amount
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(df['amount'], bins=10)
plt.title('Amount Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output2.png')

# Plot a bar chart for hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=df)
plt.title('Hour of Day Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output3.png')
